summary.name: Murph.AI
summary.one_liner: Murph.AI is a claimed "Organization as a Service" platform that deploys virtual organizations of AI agents (called HSEs) run by the ExOS operating system on AWS Bedrock AgentCore.
use_cases: deploying a virtual team of AI agents for sales, legal and finance
scaling agent capacity for product launches or busy seasons
relationship and contact intelligence across customers
governed autonomous decision-making with escalation to humans
auditing and monitoring behavior of AI agents
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Murph.AI as a platform for deploying organizations of AI agents, called Human Synthesized Entities (HSEs), each reportedly synthesized from 34 personality dimensions and given role-specific knowledge and memory. The ExOS layer is described as handling agent-to-agent communication, handoffs, and doctrine-based decisions, with confidence thresholds that escalate low-confidence actions to humans. OrgCloud is presented as the infrastructure layer, described as running on AWS Bedrock AgentCore across three regions. The page also lists a Rolodex/CRM relationship feature, memory features (Memory Genesis, Quantum Recall), a command center for fleet monitoring, and an on-chain identity/audit feature called OmniChain. Pricing is listed as Individual, Team, and OrgCloud Enterprise tiers, but all show "Contact Us" or "Custom" rather than published prices.
notable: Organizations of AI agents (HSEs) deployed via ExOS and OrgCloud on AWS Bedrock AgentCore
SoulShield encryption with killswitch and on-chain identity records (OmniChain)
caveats: Pricing is not published; tiers are listed as 'Contact Us' or 'Custom'.
FedRAMP Moderate authorization is described as 'in progress', and HIPAA BAAs are described as available rather than confirmed.

Headline metrics (500+ agents, 94% behavioral accuracy, 99.99% uptime) are self-reported marketing claims; the page calls the 'Organization as a Service' category new and the claims are not independently verified.
